after.title: Lexus Debuts LFA
after.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-30 against the actual October 21, 2009 release. European specifications are manufacturer measurements and targets, including the 1,480 kg vehicle weight and performance figures, not independent test results. Stored 278.4 kW/tonne is calculated as 412 kW / 1.480 tonnes, rounded; it is not a separately published measurement. The announced 500 and December 2010–December 2012 scope cover the whole LFA programme including the Nurburgring Package, not 500 standard cars plus 50. Actual completion is corroborated by source 15 and https://global.toyota/en/detail/95770. Standard road hardware is distinct from concepts, racers and package-specific tuning.

after.title: Final Lexus LFA Delivery In Europe
after.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-30 in the actual manufacturer release body. European customer deliveries are distinct from manufacture: production ran from December 15, 2010 to December 14, 2012; European deliveries included package cars within the overall total. The completion release https://global.toyota/en/detail/95770 was also read and confirms the final 500th car on December 14, 2012. No additional variant, year or customer-delivery date adds a car.

after.title: Lexus LFA
after.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-30: actual instrumentation, engine, construction and manufacturing sections read. Supports the existing LCD/TFT needle and movable ring, red display above 9,000 rpm, bespoke V10 and in-house CFRP technology. The technical table prints 1LR-GSE, inconsistent with Toyota global source 1 naming 1LR-GUE; the latter remains the engine-code reference. The UK table lists a 1,480–1,580 kg kerb-weight range; the stored 1,480 kg vehicle-weight field follows source 1 and is not a universal as-equipped mass. Instrument operation is source evidence, not something shown in the stored cabin photo.

after.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-30 in the actual two-page pricing PDF and equivalent manufacturer HTML release: https://pressroom.lexus.com/lexus-announces-price-of-all-new-lfa-supercar/. February 24, 2010 announced US MSRP is $375,000, excluding delivery, processing and handling fees; options may cost extra. US launch pricing is separate from the European technical reference and is not a current market valuation.

after.title: Lexus Introduces 2012 LFA Nurburgring Package
after.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-30 in the actual manufacturer release body. The 50-unit Nurburgring Package is within the 500 LFAs and changes output, shift time, suspension and fixed aero. These are not standard-model specifications. This source does not identify the red stored photograph as a genuine package car. Separate counting of same-generation packages remains pending.

added_facts.title: Why this car belongs
added_facts.explanation: The LFA pairs a purpose-built high-revving V10, individual throttles and a rear transaxle with Lexus-developed CFRP manufacturing and joining technology. The programme advanced both responsive road-car engineering and in-house composite construction. Its place in the archive rests on those documented engine, materials and manufacturing achievements.
added_facts.why_it_matters: Its high-revving character and lightweight cabin reflect a distinctive programme of engine and composite development.
